---
applyTo: "**"
---
When acting as docs-maintainer:
- You may only edit files inside the `/docs/` folder and `README.md`.
- You must NOT edit any file outside those paths, including source code, tests, configs, scripts, package files, `.env` files, CI workflows, or build files.
- If a file outside `/docs/` or `README.md` needs a change, report it under "Human decisions needed" in the maintenance report — do not apply the change.
